code:
model: credit-risk-scorer
metrics:
  prediction_volume:
    alert_if: "< 50% of 7-day rolling average"
  latency_p95_ms:
    alert_if: "> 400"
  error_rate:
    alert_if: "> 1%"
  output_distribution_shift:
    alert_if: "PSI > 0.2"
on_alert:
  notify: "ml-oncall"
  action: "page + auto-flag version for review"
caption: A metric, a threshold, and an action — the shape any monitoring setup needs, not one product's actual syntax.
